summary: This is an SSH configuration block that defines connection settings for a remote server. When you try to connect to 'planethoster', SSH will automatically use these predefined values instead of requiring you to specify them each time.

explanations.1: This creates a named alias called 'planethoster' that you can use as shorthand when connecting with SSH (instead of typing the full hostname).
explanations.5: This tells SSH which private key file to use for authentication when connecting to this host. The tilde (~) means your home directory.
